newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 30.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Sugar producer and building materials group CSR Ltd has held preliminary merger talks with sugar rivals Mackay Refined Sugars and Manildra Harwood, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday.

MIM Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it expected production costs from its A$290 million Enterprise copper mine extension at Mount Isa to average less than US$0.60 a pound by about 1999. MIM managing director Nick Stump also said the Mount Isa mine was was operating "about break even at this time," but added "it was really hard to tell", due to copper prices and the Australian dollar exchange rate.

Australia's International Air Services Commission announced on Monday determinations allowing Ansett Australia to commence operations to China and for Qantas Airways Ltd to expand services on that route.

Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) chief executive David Murray said on Sunday the bank still expected a flat result for the 1996/97 year ending June 30. "I think the oulook is still as we put it at June and that is for a flat year, because we're also incurring the funding cost of that billion dollar buy back of shares," Murray told the Nine Network's Business Sunday programme. He also said the bank had increased its market share of housing finance approvals by about six percentage points since June.
* Energy Resources of Australia Ltd A$6.25 (+0.25)

Energy Resources of Australia Ltd is studying options for increasing sales of uranium to France following endorsement by Paris of a ban on tests of nuclear weapons, ERA managing director Phil Shirvington said on Friday.
